mapper.insert: INSERT INTO challenges ( owner_id, title, description, type, target_value, start_date, end_date, goal_count, max_participants, current_head_count, is_public, invitation_code, created_at ) VALUES ( #{ownerId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{type}, #{targetValue}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{goalCount}, #{maxParticipants}, #{currentHeadCount}, #{isPublic}, #{invitationCode}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_challenges WHERE challenge_id = #{challengeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO challenge_invitations (challenge_id, inviter_id, invitee_id, status, created_at) VALUES (#{challengeId}, #{inviterId}, #{inviteeId}, 'PENDING', NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT -- [챌린지 정보] c.challenge_id AS challengeId, c.title, c.description, c.type, c.target_value AS targetValue, c.start_date AS startDate, c.end_date AS endDate, c.goal_count AS goalCount,
-- [유저 참여 현황] uc.user_challenge_id AS userChallengeId, uc.status, uc.last_success_date AS lastSuccessDate,
-- 참여 여부 (ID 존재 시 true) CASE WHEN uc.user_challenge_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isJoined,
-- Null 방지 (참여 안 했으면 0) IFNULL(uc.current_count, 0) AS currentCount, IFNULL(uc.current_streak, 0) AS currentStreak, IFNULL(uc.max_streak, 0) AS maxStreak,
-- [달성률 계산] (현재 / 목표 * 100) CASE WHEN uc.user_challenge_id IS NULL OR c.goal_count = 0 THEN 0 WHEN uc.current_count >= c.goal_count THEN 100 ELSE FLOOR((uc.current_count / c.goal_count) * 100) END AS progressPercent
FROM challenges c JOIN user_challenges uc ON c.challenge_id = uc.challenge_id AND uc.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.start_date DESC, c.created_at DESC

SELECT /* UserChallenge 정보 */ uc.user_challenge_id AS userChallengeId, uc.current_count AS currentCount, uc.current_streak AS currentStreak, uc.max_streak AS maxStreak, uc.last_success_date AS lastSuccessDate, uc.status AS status, /* Challenge 정보 */ c.challenge_id AS challengeId, c.title AS title, c.type AS type, c.target_value AS targetValue, c.start_date AS startDate, c.end_date AS endDate, c.goal_count AS goalCount FROM user_challenges uc JOIN challenges c ON uc.challenge_id = c.challenge_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.status = 'PROGRESS'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_challenges ( user_id, challenge_id, status, current_count, current_streak, max_streak, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{challengeId}, 'PROGRESS', 0, -- 초기 횟수 0 0, -- 초기 스트릭 0 0, -- 초기 최대 스트릭 0 NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE user_challenges SET current_count = #{currentCount}, current_streak = #{currentStreak}, max_streak = #{maxStreak}, last_success_date = #{lastSuccessDate}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_challenge_id = #{userChallengeId}
UPDATE user_challenges SET status = 'SUCCESS', updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_challenge_id = #{userChallengeId}
UPDATE user_challenges SET status = 'FAIL', updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_challenge_id = #{userChallengeId}
mapper.select:
SELECT c.challenge_id AS challengeId, c.owner_id AS ownerId, c.title, c.description, c.type, c.target_value AS targetValue, c.start_date AS startDate, c.end_date AS endDate, c.goal_count AS goalCount, c.max_participants AS maxParticipants, c.is_public AS isPublic, c.invitation_code AS invitationCode, c.current_head_count AS currentHeadCount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_challenges uc_count WHERE uc_count.challenge_id = c.challenge_id) as currentHeadCount,
CASE WHEN uc.user_challenge_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isJoined,
uc.status, IFNULL(uc.current_count, 0) AS currentCount, IFNULL(uc.current_streak, 0) AS currentStreak, IFNULL(uc.max_streak, 0) AS maxStreak, uc.last_success_date AS lastSuccessDate,
CASE WHEN uc.user_challenge_id IS NULL OR c.goal_count = 0 THEN 0 WHEN uc.current_count >= c.goal_count THEN 100 ELSE FLOOR((uc.current_count / c.goal_count) * 100) END AS progressPercent
FROM challenges c LEFT JOIN user_challenges uc ON c.challenge_id = uc.challenge_id AND uc.user_id = #{userId} WHERE c.challenge_id = #{challengeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE challenges SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, type = #{type}, target_value = #{targetValue}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, goal_count = #{goalCount}, max_participants = #{maxParticipants}, is_public = #{isPublic} WHERE challenge_id = #{challengeId}
mapper.select:
SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, u.profile_image AS profileImage,
CASE WHEN c.goal_count > 0 THEN TRUNCATE((uc.current_count * 100) / c.goal_count, 0) ELSE 0 END AS progressPercent
FROM user_challenges uc JOIN users u ON uc.user_id = u.user_id JOIN challenges c ON uc.challenge_id = c.challenge_id WHERE uc.challenge_id = #{challengeId} ORDER BY uc.created_at ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_challenges WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND challenge_id = #{challengeId}
mapper.select: SELECT invitation_id AS invitationId, challenge_id AS challengeId, inviter_id AS inviterId, invitee_id AS inviteeId, status, created_at AS createdAt FROM invitations WHERE invitation_id = #{invitationId}
